calls.title: Dmitry / Christian
calls.summary: The team evaluated AB testing platforms, prioritizing open source solutions to manage a target of 10 experiments per month. GrowthBook was favored for its open-source nature, allowing internal maintenance and avoiding vendor dependence. The need for on-premises hosting was emphasized to ensure data control and security. Dmitriy is compiling a competitor matrix that includes Three Sigma and LaunchDarkly for feature comparison. Usability and support were highlighted as critical differentiators, with Christian noting GrowthBook’s superior UI and fast customer support. The commercial pricing for GrowthBook starts at $50,000 annually for 10 users, with additional users costing about $1,000 each. The implementation plan involves starting with the open source version to minimize costs and clarify feature needs before moving to commercial licenses.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Enterprise Pricing, Open Source, Support SLA, Competitor Matrix
